### OECDsppps
[Code]{.tag-pill .tag-code} · [{{< fa brands r-project >}} R]{.pkg-lang}

Calculates subnational Purchasing Power Parities (sPPPs) across OECD regions.

[[GitHub ↗](https://github.com/amannj/OECDsppps) [Vignettes ↗](https://amannj.github.io/OECDsppps/articles/index.html)]{.pkg-links}
